summary: The test suite is exceptional. The Pester unit tests comprehensively cover the core logic (glob parsing, priority ordering, multiple labels, exclusive rules, error handling) using well-structured test isolation with temporary files. The custom `Run-ActTests.ps1` harness flawlessly implements the rigorous end-to-end requirements by dynamically scaffolding isolated Git repositories, running `act` efficiently, persisting outputs to the requested artifact, and strictly asserting precise string matches and exit codes. Furthermore, `Workflow.Tests.ps1` robustly asserts all workflow structural constraints and leverages `actionlint`. Highly reliable and professionally structured.
